title: HELIX: HEterogeneous LLM Inference with FleXible and Fine-Grained Partitioning
title_zh: HELIX：基于灵活且细粒度切分的异构大语言模型推理

paragraphs.en: HELIX以算子粒度自动发现并调度切分方案到异构加速器，解码延迟提升最高3.5倍。 LLM inference is inherently heterogeneous, with performance bottlenecks shifting throughout inference phases down to individual operators. This has motivated heterogeneous serving systems that disaggregate execution across specialized accelerators, typically through fixed partitions such as prefill/decode or attention/FFN. However, these approaches commit to a partitioning strategy in advance, limiting their ability to adapt to different workloads and model architectures while forcing emerging accelerators into predefined roles. We present HELIX, a vLLM-based software stack that discovers, compiles and dispatches workload-aware partitions across heterogeneous accelerators at the operator granularity. At engine initialization, HELIX automatically determines hardware-specific operator placements that minimize execution latency, accounting for profiled execution costs, communication overheads, device capabilities, and memory constraints. It combines dynamic programming, piecewise compilation, and heterogeneous subgraph dispatch, enabling accelerators with partial operator coverage to participate in LLM inference without predefined model partitions. HELIX provides an open-source unified framework for exploring, evaluating, and integrating heterogeneous accelerators for LLM inference, lowering the barrier to emerging hardware by exposing them as subgraph executors. In systems combining H100 and B200 GPUs with emerging accelerators, HELIX resolves LLM partitions that multi-query decoding latency by up to 3$\times$ for dense and sparse transformer models and up to 3.5$\times$ for hybrid state-space models, relative to standard attention-FFN disaggregation.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 推理本质上是异构的，其性能瓶颈会随着推理阶段的变化而移动，甚至下探到单个算子层面。 这催生了将执行过程分解到专用加速器上的异构服务系统，通常采用固定的划分方式，例如 prefill/decode 或 attention/FFN。 然而，这些方法提前固定了划分策略，限制了其适应不同工作负载和模型架构的能力，同时迫使新兴加速器接受预先定义的角色。 我们提出了 HELIX，一个基于 vLLM 的软件栈，能够以算子粒度发现、编译并分发工作负载感知的划分方案到异构加速器上。 在引擎初始化时，HELIX 自动确定能够最小化执行延迟的硬件相关算子放置方案，同时综合考虑经过剖析的执行成本、通信开销、设备能力以及内存约束。 它结合了动态规划、分段编译和异构子图分发，使算子覆盖不完整的加速器也能参与 LLM 推理，而无需预先定义的模型划分。 HELIX 提供了一个开源的统一框架，用于探索、评估和集成面向 LLM 推理的异构加速器，通过将新兴硬件暴露为子图执行器来降低其使用门槛。 在由 H100 和 B200 GPU 与新兴加速器组成的系统中，相较于标准的 attention-FFN 分解方式，HELIX 求得的 LLM 划分方案可将稠密和稀疏 Transformer 模型的多查询解码延迟最高降低 3 倍，将混合状态空间模型的解码延迟最高降低 3.5 倍。
